lessonTitle: What Are the Properties of Matter?
title: Prop Check

badge.name: Prop Master
badge.line: Only VR crews earn this one. Your shot goes in Opti's film.

hook.look: This is a prop list. Props are the things actors use in a film.
hook.head: Scene 26 · Prop Check
hook.alt: Old black and white photo of students looking at rocks and minerals in museum cases
hook.cap: Students visit the Hall of Gems and Minerals at the Smithsonian's National Museum of Natural History.
hook.note: Every rock in those cases has properties you can see and test. What can you find out about our props?

opti.brief: Welcome to the lab, crew. We film Scene 26, Prop Check. Show me how our props are different, then take the shot.
opti.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Read each clue and clear the prop table. Then tell me what you think.

steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Science in Filter environments. Click OptimaED Science Lab, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Pick one property, like hardness or size. Line up the Granite Block, Golf Ball, Soccer Ball and Snowball by that property. Set the Scale at the end.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “I lined them up by ___. The ___ is ___, but the ___ is ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add a tool that measures length: Ruler

vr.full: Your photo shows the Granite Block, Golf Ball, Soccer Ball and Snowball in a line, with the Scale at the end.

studio.title: Find the mystery prop

labels.start: Read the clue. Which props do not fit?
labels.done: Only the golf ball is left. It is hard, round and white, and it has more mass than a ping-pong ball. You found the mystery prop!

studio.look: A property is something you can see, feel or measure, like color, shape or hardness. Eight real props sit on the prop table. One of them is the mystery prop.
studio.do: Read the clue. Tap every prop that does not fit, or drag it to Off the table. Keep going until one prop is left.

frames.lead: 1. How did you find the mystery prop?
frames.starter: I found it because it is ___, ___ and ___.

studio.full: You used all 4 clues to find the mystery prop. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

voice.brief: Welcome to the lab, crew. We film Scene 26, Prop Check. Show me how our props are different, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Science, and pick OptimaED Science Lab. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Line up the granite, the golf ball, the soccer ball and the snowball. Pick one property. Then tell me how they differ.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a tool that measures length. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Read each clue and clear the prop table. Then tell me what you think.
